obfuscation_indicators: cannot accurately predict future commodity prices
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and well quantified, but highlights meaningful deterioration in fiscal 2024, including lower revenue and net income, an 11% reserve decline, and higher operating costs. Commodity-price volatility, reduced permitting activity, production declines, and dependence on operator activity remain material risks. Management presents its mineral-ownership strategy positively, though some explanations rely on broad causal language and standard forward-looking disclaimers.
